firm_data.firm_description: Lacy Katzen LLP, based in Rochester, New York, has been providing customized legal solutions since 1950. The firm offers a wide range of legal services with a team-based approach.
notable_facts: Lacy Katzen LLP has multiple locations in Rochester and surrounding areas.
The firm employs a team-based approach with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative personnel in each practice area.

email.subject: AI for Lacy Katzen LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jennifer,

Seventy years of customized legal solutions across Corporate & Banking, Business, and Default Services puts Lacy Katzen in a strong position. That team-based approach you've built is exactly what gives firms like yours the agility to compete.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Rochester to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
